Create and operate persistent development machines

Usage:
  schooner [flags]
  schooner [command]

Available Commands:
  box         Add and operate development boxes
  clone       Clone a Repository onto a Box
  completion  Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  db          Manage local Schooner database state
  doctor      Check this machine for Schooner readiness
  help        Help about any command
  logs        Capture bounded history from a managed Session
  provider    Manage cloud provider credential profiles
  pull        Bring a Box workspace into the current local checkout
  push        Put the current local workspace onto a Box
  resume      Return to an existing live Session
  sessions    List live managed and unmanaged tmux Sessions
  shell       Open an ephemeral shell in a live Worktree
  source      Manage source-host access for Boxes
  start       Open persistent work for a Repository
  stop        Stop a managed Session without changing its Worktree
  update      Check or update the local Schooner executable
  version     Show Schooner build information
  worktree    Discover and inspect live Git worktrees

Flags:
      --accessible      use screen-reader-friendly prompts and progress
      --color string    color mode: auto, always, or never (default "auto")
  -h, --help            help for schooner
      --no-input        disable interactive prompts
      --output string   output format: human or json (default "human")
      --theme string    terminal theme: auto, light, or dark (default "auto")
  -v, --version         version for schooner

Use "schooner [command] --help" for more information about a command.
